annotations.annotation: Note: Due to the observed damage to the EM cable, the winched profiler has been returned to the dock and secured. Detailed inspection of engineering video of the Shallow Profiler-Endurance EM cable recorded earlier in the deployment indicates the anomalies most likely occurred in October 2016. Based on the video, it appears only the outer strength member is compromised. Due to the possibility the damage will continue to get worse and not wanting to risk the Science Pod (SciP) breaking free, profiling at this site has been restricted; however the SciP remains powered with its instruments active and collecting/transmitting data.

Due to errors during vendor calibration, a calibration offset (CC_offset) of 9.6 is being applied during the on-demand creation of the L1 Seawater Pressure (dbar) data product from this instrument. For more information please contact help@oceanobservatories.org.
Parameters: corrected_dissolved_oxygen, ext_volt0. Suspect values due to possible sensor malfunction.
